elements.requirement: The Limitation Act 1980 does not apply to any action or arbitration for which a period of limitation is prescribed by or under any other enactment, regardless of whether that other enactment was passed before or after the passing of the Limitation Act 1980.
elements.quote: This Act shall not apply to any action or arbitration for which a period of limitation is prescribed by or under any other enactment (whether passed before or after the passing of this Act)

elements.requirement: The Limitation Act 1980 does not apply to any action or arbitration to which the Crown is a party if a period of limitation would be prescribed by or under another enactment had the action or arbitration been between subjects.
elements.quote: or to any action or arbitration to which the Crown is a party and for which, if it were between subjects, a period of limitation would be prescribed by or under any such other enactment
